name: Dribbble Creative Showcase Clone
tagline: Pixel-perfect designer showcase feed with dynamic tag filtering and interactive shot cards.
description: High-fidelity front-facing recreation of the Dribbble design exploration platform, focusing on editorial typography, responsive masonry media feeds, fluid hover overlays, and designer engagement flows.
problem: Media-heavy design portfolios require seamless image loading, responsive grid adjustments across diverse aspect ratios, and instant visual feedback without degrading viewport frame rates.
solution: Built a modern React single-page application implementing responsive CSS grid/flex layouts, interactive designer shot overlays, categorical tag filtering, and subtle micro-interactions.
metrics_and_highlights: Engineered dynamic responsive grid layouts accommodating diverse design shot ratios from mobile through ultrawide displays.
Built interactive shot hover cards with animated creator attribution badges, view counters, and instant save/like actions.
Integrated multi-category tag filtering (Animation, Branding, Mobile, Web Design) with instant client-side state updates.
Optimized media asset rendering to maintain smooth 60fps scrolling performance.

showcase_and_grid_engine: Responsive masonry/grid feed featuring hover-triggered metadata (author, likes, saves)
Category discovery bar with horizontal scrolling and dynamic active-filter states
Designer hero section featuring high-impact visual banners and promotional CTA paths
client_interactions_and_layout: Interactive shot detail modals presenting high-resolution assets and project descriptions
Sticky navigation header with dynamic search inputs and responsive collapse menus
Modular, reusable UI card primitives adhering to modern component architecture
